title: Garden City
description: Originally nicknamed the Garden City of India for its farms and parks, Bengaluru has been transformed by the tech industry into the country’s version of Silicon Valley. National Geographic Explorer Sayan Hazra photographed this recently designed pocket of native plants in the growing metropolis as part of his project documenting green spaces in urban areas.
translated_description: 班加罗尔最初因农场和公园众多而被称为“印度花园城市”，如今科技产业已将其转变为印度的“硅谷”。国家地理探险家萨扬·哈兹拉在拍摄城市绿地项目时，拍下了这座不断扩张的大都市中一片新设计的本土植物小天地。
